title: मसान नाटकमा नारीवाद
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेखमा गोपालप्रसाद रिमालको मसान नाटकमा नारीवादी चेतनाको प्रभाव कसरी र के कस्तो अवस्थामा परे को छ ? भन्ने जिज्ञासा उठाई त्यसलाई नारीवादी सिद्धान्तका स्थापित मान्यताका आधारमा विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । पुरुषभित्र विकसित नारीलार्ई भोगविलासको साधन ठान्ने प्रवृत्तिको चित्रण रहेको छ । नाटकमा कृष्णले युवतीको मातृृत्व नाश गरेबाट नारीप्रतिको अत्याचार विकसित भएको छ । युवती, दुलही, वाग्मती र भोटुकी आमाले आफ्ना पतिको बेवास्ता र कामाशक्त प्रवृत्तिका कारण मानसिक प्रताडना सहेका छन् । यहाँ युवती र दुलहीले पतिको व्यवहारप्रति आक्रोश व्यक्त गरेको देखिन्छ । आफ्नो मातृत्व हत्या भएको बुझेर युवतीले पति गृह त्यागेबाट नारीहरूमा विद्रोहको चेतना जाग्न लागेको पाइन्छ । मसान नाटकमा नारीचेतना शीर्षकभित्र विषयपरिचय, अध्ययनको विधि, नारीवादी सिद्धान्त, मसान नाटकको विश्लेषणजस्ता उपशीर्षकका आधारमा नाटकको विश्लेषण गरी नारीहरूमा विद्रोहको चेतना सशक्त बन्दै गएको निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ । In the presented article, how and what is the influence of feminist consciousness in Gopal Prasad Rimal's play Masan? Having raised the question, it has been analyzed based on the established principles of feminist theory. There is a depiction of the tendency developed in men to regard women as instruments of pleasure. In the drama, the tyranny of women has developed since Krishna destroyed the motherhood of the young woman. Young women, brides, eloquent and mothers of Bhoti have endured mental torture due to their husband's neglect and impotence. Here, the girl and the bride seem to express their anger towards the husband's behavior. Realizing that her motherhood has been murdered, young women abandon their husbands and start to awaken a sense of rebellion in women. Analyzing the play on the basis of subtitles such as introduction, method of study, feminist theory, analysis of Masan drama under the heading of women's consciousness in Masan drama. It has been concluded that the awareness of rebellion among women is becoming stronger.
american_english: In the presented article, the question was raised as to how the feminist consciousness in Gopal Prasad Rimal's play Masan gave rise to a condition and in what way, and it was then analyzed based on the established principles of feminist theory. A tendency to regard women as instruments of pleasure has been depicted. It was shown that cruelty toward women developed in the play after Krishna destroyed the young woman's motherhood. Young women, brides, eloquent women and mothers of Bhoti endured mental distress due to their husbands' neglect and impotence. Here, it can be seen that the young woman and the bride expressed their anger at the husband's behaviour. Upon realizing that her motherhood had been killed, the young woman abandoned her husband and had to awaken a sense of rebellion among women. Under the heading Feminist consciousness in the Masan play, on the basis of sub-headings such as the introduction of the subject, the method of the study, the feminist theory and the analysis of the Masan play, the play was analyzed and the conclusion was drawn that the awareness of rebellion among women was growing stronger.

Young women, brides, the chatty ones and the Bhoti mums endured mental grief because of their husbands' neglect and impotence. Here you can see the young woman and the bride letting out their anger at the husband's behaviour. Once they realised their motherhood had been killed, the young woman ditched the husband and started to wake a sense of rebellion among women. Under the heading Feminist consciousness in the Masan play, the play was analysed on the basis of sub-headings such as the introduction of the subject, the method of the study, the feminist theory and the analysis of the Masan play, and a conclusion was drawn that the sense of rebellion among women was getting stronger.
informal_english: So in the presented article, the big question was how the feminist awareness went in Gopal Prasad Rimal's play Masan and what sort of state it ended up in, and then they gave it a proper going-over based on the accepted feminist theory. There's a fair go at showing the trend blokes picked up where they started seeing women as a bit of fun, an instrument for pleasure, you know. In the play, when Krishna took out the young woman's motherhood, the way women got treated went downhill. The young ones, the brides, the chatty ladies and the Bhoti mums all copped mental strain from their husbands giving them the cold shoulder or being useless. Here you can see the young woman and the bride letting rip their anger at the husband's behaviour. When they realised their motherhood had been killed, the young woman gave the old man the boot and started getting the women of the place clued up about rebelling. Under the heading Feminist consciousness in the Masan play, they broke the play down under sub-headings like the subject intro, the study method, the feminist theory and the Masan play analysis, and worked out that the women were getting a stronger sense of rebellion.
